pass_semantics: exact scenario coverage, shared decoder traces, lane-native physics/statistics, provenance and nonmixing gates pass; no universal comparator superiority is implied

decoder_lane.nonexecution_reason: different decision target, horizon, information set, or protocol-native metric; retained for later matched lanes, never scored as a loss here
decoder_lane.shared_trace_contract: all six methods decode identical displacement/residual truth per scenario-seed-window; predictors update only after current-window decoding
decoder_lane.training_contract: hyperparameters and static parameters are fit only on disjoint original T3.2.2 training scenarios/seeds before all T5.1.2 evaluation

claim_boundary.forbidden: device-calibrated fault rates, master-equation fidelity, or secondary-protocol hardware execution

checks.criterion: max paired absolute run difference <= limit

checks.detail: logical identity and logical flip endpoints

checks.criterion: max P_e in unaffected quadrature <= limit

source_anchors.fragment: a displacement of amplitude $ l_{S}/4 $ makes a large-distance error
distance to the closest logical operation
consecutive e outcomes in the same-quadrature cycles

limitations: coarse-grained error-space depth, not a Fock-space displacement simulation
readout and recovery probabilities are explicit project assumptions, not device calibration
reproduces the qualitative nonmonotonic trend, not Fig. 4(c) pixel values
no target-board timing, microwave waveform or real quantum-hardware evidence

tail_correlation.removal_rule: drop full trajectories with observed leakage run >=2 cycles

checks.criterion: combined syndrome CI contains hidden mean

source_anchors.fragment: expectation value of the code projector $ \langle \Pi_{0}\rangle=0.825\pm 0.003 $

limitations: hidden state is a coarse-grained recovery-depth process, not a Fock-space state
leakage start/duration use source-inspired effective assumptions
syndrome estimator is first-order and reports the explicit p_err squared model bound
correlation removal is post-selection, not an online leakage-removal controller
no target-device calibration or experimental raw-data fit

claim_boundary.allowed: the ten registered mixed scenarios were actually executed in their native lanes with frozen seeds, paired decoder traces, fresh component runs and explicit lane-local metrics
claim_boundary.forbidden: a global leaderboard, algorithm selection from evaluation results, finite-energy or device lifetime equivalence, device-calibrated fault rates, deployable oracle claims, or universal adaptive/NMF/CNN superiority
